version: endpoint study 2026-11-26 (default branch; commit not pinned: no code copied)
attribution: The Proton public key server lookup (api.protonmail.ch/pks/lookup?op=index) and the reading of the key creation epoch as an approximate account creation date are adapted from ProtOSINT by pixelbubble (MIT licence). V3LUM reimplements the request and parser; ProtOSINT's account.proton.me users/available method (a registration oracle) is not adopted.
